# Emmanuel Sogelola

> Security engineer and founder building across incident response, financial systems, and human-centered AI.

Canonical site: https://esogelola.com/

## Primary pages

- [Portfolio](https://esogelola.com/): Selected writing, experience, and active projects.
- [About](https://esogelola.com/about): Background, working philosophy, and professional interests.
- [Machines That Wait](https://esogelola.com/writing/machines-that-wait): An essay on provenance, permission, and why fluent systems should stop before they act.

## Selected projects

- [Munk Financial](https://www.munkfinancial.com/): AI-native financial intelligence for everyday people.
- BoB-26: Spiderbot: A voice-channel research project on trust, restraint, and human oversight.
- Solomon Platform: Local and web agents with visible, provenance-rich execution.
- Automaton: A provenance-first agent library where intelligence is decoupled from authority.
